' "$TMPDIR/infra376/skills" > "$TMPDIR/infra376/overlay.yml" && cd "$TMPDIR/infra376" && omp --config "$TMPDIR/infra376/overlay.yml" -p --no-session --tools read "Call the read tool once on skill://legion-architect and once on skill://legion-architect/references/wake-routing.md.
